title: Total cut complexes and their duals
summary: We study the total $d$-cut complexes and their Alexander duals. We give some results about the connectivity in general and in terms of the grith of the graph. For $d\geq3$, the homotopy type of these complexes is calculated for: $p$th power of a cycle with at least $(2r)d$ vertices where $p\leq r$; the $r$th power of a cycle with at least $2rd-(r-1)$ vertices where $r\geq3$; and the $2$th power of a cycle with at least $3d$ vertices.
